Contributing

Contributions are welcome. Here are some ways to get involved:

  • Report bugs via GitHub Issues
  • Submit feature requests: describe the use case and expected behavior
  • Open pull requests for bug fixes or new features

Workflow

  1. Fork the repository
  2. Create a feature branch (git checkout -b feat/my-feature)
  3. Make your changes and test them (cargo test, cargo clippy)
  4. Push and open a pull request against main

Building from Source

Prerequisites: a Rust toolchain. Install one via rustup.rs if you do not have one already.

terminal 
git clone https://github.com/sylvainHellin/mailypoppins
cd mailypoppins
cargo build --release

To install the binary to ~/.cargo/bin/:

terminal 
cargo install --path .
